resources.string: Test app with an experimental face surface scan; not a complete 3D head.

On first launch the app downloads about 3.6 MB of model data from Google over HTTPS and verifies it. Google can see your IP address; mobile data charges may apply. Detection does not need a connection afterwards.
Model ready. You can start the test.
The model could not be prepared. Check your internet connection and try again.
The report contains device type, Android version and technical test counts, but no photos or face points. It is only shared when you copy or deliberately send it.
Copied. You can now paste the report into the chat.
Device self-tests – projection: %1$s; MediaPipe: %2$s; front camera: %3$s
Run the synthetic 3D math test and start the camera test. Complete the three five-second checks, then copy the test report. These checks do not test a 3D model.
For each test, get into position first, then press the matching button and wait 5 seconds.
Enable airplane mode and turn off Wi-Fi and other networks, then try again.
Test running – please stay in position for 5 seconds.
%1$s: %2$d of %3$d results matched. Details are in the test report.
M0 geometry test: not run yet.
M0 geometry test running; please wait …
M0 geometry test passed. Values are in the report.
M0 geometry test failed. Details are in the report.
Hold phone and head steady, look straight ahead, and capture neutral first. Then start the four-second expression recording. Move your face, not your head. Images are not saved.
Face detected – hold still for capture.
Waiting for a face in the camera.
Not enough recent face points yet. Hold still and try again.
Neutral captured (%1$d frames, variation %2$.1f px). Ready to record expression.
The face points cannot be used. Please capture again.

Only the visible front-camera face surface: no texture, hair or back of head. Depth and scale are not metrically calibrated; absolute accuracy has not been measured. Head motion can appear as expression. The model stays in memory until export.
Landmark variation during capture: neutral %1$.1f px, expression %2$.1f px. This is stability, not 3D accuracy.
Drag to rotate. The slider follows the recorded sequence. Playback repeats the sequence and may jump at the end.
GLB saved. It contains face data – share it deliberately.
Export failed. An incomplete file may remain at the chosen destination; please check and try again.
Neutral capture unusable: fit your entire face closer in the frame and hold still for several seconds. This is only a rough heuristic.
Recording (4 seconds). Keep your face in view and change expression.
Recording failed or was interrupted. Keep your face in view and try again.
Recording cancelled. You can start again.
Neutral landmark variation: %1$.1f px. This measures stability, not 3D accuracy.
Prototype: real scanning is not available yet.
Everything stays on your phone. No cloud, no account.

FaceScan needs camera access for preview and scanning. Images are not saved. Face points and the model stay in memory during use; a file is written only if you explicitly export it. You can decline and go back.
If the system prompt no longer appears, you can change the permission in app settings.
The front camera could not be started. Please check the permission and try again.
Demo: Waiting for camera frames and detection.
Demo: No face detected. No 3D model is created.
Demo: Face detected. No 3D model is created yet.
Demo: Model missing – face detection is unavailable. Preview works without the model.
Demo: Face detection failed. You can still use the preview and demo.
Demo: face points are not captured yet.
Progress is simulated; no model is calculated.
This is only a preview of the flow.
